title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: recording a review decision (desk action)
content:
## Situation of use and capability
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product this action records the line's decision on a dangerous-goods acceptance that is under review, and books the administration fee that goes with an approval. One call closes the review. An approval marks the acceptance approved with the day of the call as the approval date and, when the administration fee passed is not 0.00, writes one administration-fee charge dated that day on the acceptance's dangerous-goods account, adding it to the charges the acceptance owes; an approval passed with 0.00 writes no charge. A rejection marks the acceptance rejected with the day of the call as the rejection date and writes no charge.

## How it is invoked
The action is record_dg_review_decision_9aa03de9, an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then called (call_agent_discoverable_tool) by the agent.

## Parameters
| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| dg_id | reference number of the dangerous-goods acceptance under review, as shown by the dangerous-goods acceptance lookup | identifier, text |
| decision | the outcome of the review | accepts only one of: approved (the line accepts the goods for the booking's current sailing), rejected (the line refuses the goods and nothing is charged) |
| admin_fee_usd | the administration fee booked with this decision | US dollars, 2 decimal places; 0.00 means no administration-fee charge is written, and a rejection always writes none |

## Return
The receipt lists dg_id, status (approved or rejected as recorded), decision_date (the date of the decision, YYYY-MM-DD), admin_fee_usd (the administration fee booked, 2 decimal places; 0.00 for a rejection) and charges_due_usd (the acceptance's outstanding dangerous-goods charges after the decision, 2 decimal places). The call has succeeded when the receipt shows the new status and, for an approval, the fee booked. A repeated identical approval writes no second charge. No other outcome is defined for this action.

## Input → effect
| decision | admin_fee_usd | Effect on the acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| approved | above 0.00 | status approved, approval date set, one administration-fee charge written |
| approved | 0.00 | status approved, approval date set, no charge written |
| rejected | any | status rejected, rejection date set, no charge written |
